name: Tureen with Cover
material: Hard-paste porcelain, glaze, with enamels in colors, and gilding
summary: Hard-paste porcelain, glaze, with enamels in colors, and gilding。11.4 × 19.7 × 11.4 cm (4 1/2 × 7 3/4 × 4 1/2 in.)。Anonymous gift in memory of Chauncey McCormick
history: This tureen is from a service owned by Elias Morgan (1770–1812) of Connecticut. The Morgan set, displaying the coat of arms originally used by his Welsh ancestors, is one of the few armorial services made for the American market.
